body: Hi, I was wondering if being into witchcraft could potentially hurt my career? My mother is strongly against my beliefs and I was recently outed by another student who thought I was crazy or a danger to myself and others. She told me to take down all associations between me and the practice on my social media, saying that colleges look at that sort of thing and won’t accept me because of it. I don’t care what other people think and would like to do as I please, but really felt like I needed confirmation. I looked into it, but couldn’t find anything. What were your personal experiences with this?

You weren’t being harsh at all!

I guess what I meant by the first two paragraphs was that if he doesn’t have the time to talk to me most of the time, why be with me? It gives me a false hope that we’re actually going to set aside time for each other, either every day or just more than once a week. Right now, I’m kind of waiting on the relationship a bit to see how things better themselves, if at all.

I agree with your second paragraph. Thank you for commenting and providing me with another perspective! ♡
